# HavenCraft Home (Crafting Your Everyday Haven)
> Sustainable, direct-from-manufacturer modern furniture & home essentials engineered for warm living spaces.

## Overview
HavenCraft is a direct-to-consumer & wholesale home furnishings brand operating regional fulfillment hubs across Europe (DE, FR, ES, IT), Japan (JP), and North America (US). All products are manufactured with zero-VOC finishes, FSC-certified solid woods, and OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified textiles.

## Storefront & Machine Layer Endpoints
- Homepage: https://havencraft-home.com/
- Product Catalog API: GraphQL Storefront API with @inContext(country, language)
- Machine-Readable Product PDPs: `/[lang]/products/[handle].md`
- Structured Data: Schema.org Product, Offer, AggregateRating, FAQPage, MerchantReturnPolicy

## Brand Guarantees & Terms
- Shipping: Direct local fulfillment hub dispatch within 24 hours. Express 3-5 business days delivery.
- Pricing: All listed prices in EUR, JPY, and USD include localized taxes (VAT / Consumption Tax) and free curb shipping.
- Trial & Returns: 30-Day in-home trial guarantee with complimentary reverse logistics return labels.
- Structural Warranty: 2-Year structural frame and joint manufacturer warranty.
- Sustainability: 100% FSC-certified European Oak & Birch, non-toxic organic oil finishes, CARB Phase 2 compliant.

## Top Catalog Handles
- `nordic-oak-lounger`: HavenCraft Warm Oak Ergonomic Accent Lounge Chair
- `artisan-extendable-dining-table`: HavenCraft Solid White Oak Extendable Dining Table
- `wool-throw-blanket`: HavenCraft Organic Virgin Wool Tactile Throw Blanket
- `scandinavian-cloud-sofa`: HavenCraft Minimalist Modular 3-Seater Cloud Sofa
